Tiến lên is a shedding-type card game originating in Vietnam and is often considered Vietnam's national card game. It is common in Vietnamese and Vietnamese-American communities and spread to the United States and Australia with migration. It is related to Chinese climbing games such as Big Two and Dou dizhu.
Standard 52-card. Rank: 3(low)-4-5...K-A-2(high). Suit Rank: Spades < Clubs < Diamonds < Hearts.
Deal all 13 cards to each player.
